questions.q_en:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set:

(16,22,26)
questions.solution_en:
First number + Product of individual digits of first number = second number

Second number + Product of individual digits of second number = third number

16 + (6 x 1) = 22 ; 22 + (2 x 2) = 26

Similarly

38 + (3 x 8) = 62 ; 62 + (6 x 2) = 74

Hence the correct answer is '(38, 62, 74)'.
